question: Please help me find the film category with the highest total rental hours in cities where the city's name either starts with "A" or contains a hyphen.
sql:
WITH target_cities AS (
    SELECT city_id FROM city WHERE city LIKE 'A%' OR city LIKE '%-%'
),
target_customers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id 
    FROM customer c
    JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
    WHERE a.city_id IN (SELECT city_id FROM target_cities)
),
rental_hours AS (
    SELECT 
        r.rental_id,
        r.customer_id,
        r.inventory_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN r.return_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600.0
            ELSE f.rental_duration * 24.0
        END AS hours
    FROM rental r
    JOIN target_customers tc ON r.customer_id = tc.customer_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
    JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id
)
SELECT 
    cat.name AS category_name,
    SUM(rh.hours) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental_hours rh
JOIN inventory i ON rh.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id
GROUP BY cat.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH target_cities AS (
    SELECT city_id FROM city WHERE city LIKE 'A%' OR city LIKE '%-%'
),
target_customers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id 
    FROM customer c
    JOIN address a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
    WHERE a.city_id IN (SELECT city_id FROM target_cities)
),
rental_hours AS (
    SELECT 
        r.rental_id,
        r.customer_id,
        r.inventory_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN r.return_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600.0
            ELSE f.rental_duration * 24.0
        END AS hours
    FROM rental r
    JOIN target_customers tc ON r.customer_id = tc.customer_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
    JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id
)
SELECT 
    cat.name AS category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS rental_count,
    SUM(rh.hours) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental_hours rh
JOIN inventory i ON rh.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category cat ON fc.category_id = cat.category_id
GROUP BY cat.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
